note: Lawes: the Royall Consort entries are the later 2-violin/2-bass-viol/2-theorbo scoring; the earlier 4-viol-and-theorbo version (2 treble, tenor, bass, 1 theorbo; Phantasm, Linn 2015) has no entry. Harp Consorts Nos. 3, 5, 6, 9 are missing (all on the ATMA disc, Eilander). Lawes dates: IMSLP's 1644 for the 5/6-part setts is unsupported.
